title: R0: Verify licenses/terms and locate guideline text for the 4 candidates (read-only, no downloads)
description:
## Purpose

Read-only research: verify the license / terms of the 4 candidates and locate the published guideline text for each. No downloads without the owner saying so.

## Scope

For each of EDOS (subtask B), ASAP-SAS (one prompt), CAP policy topics (US bills or NYT headlines, 5-8 confusable topics), FOMC hawkish/dovish (gtfintechlab) and the fallback Gab Hate Corpus:
- license / terms of use, with source URL and date checked; mark VERIFIED or UNVERIFIED. **Flag** Kaggle competition terms (ASAP-SAS) and CAP terms explicitly: can we use, store hashes and publish aggregate results?
- where the guideline / codebook / rubric lives (paper appendix, repo file, PDF), its approximate length in tokens, and whether it is the guideline actually given to annotators;
- the reported inter-annotator agreement or human ceiling, and on which split/metric;
- split sizes and label distribution for the subset we would use; contamination notes (publication year, likely in pretraining);
- annotator process (EDOS training + expert adjudication is UNVERIFIED: verify).
- **Download list for the owner:** what would need downloading (dataset files, guideline PDFs), from where, and size. Do not download.

## Definition of done

A comment on this issue with one table row per candidate (license + status, guideline location + length, human ceiling, sizes, contamination, download list with sizes) and a recommendation of which to carry into R1-R3. Owner asked about the download list before R1/R2 fetch anything.

## Cost

$0. No Jev or other model calls, no downloads.

comments.text:
R0 done (commit 2eca07e; studies/rubric_screen/candidates.json + README.md). Owner authorised ordinary downloads of open data in this run; data in .data/rubric-screen/ (gitignored, not committed).
- EDOS B: USABLE. Licence CC0 1.0 (repo LICENSE, github.com/rewire-online/edos), verified. Guideline = repo guidelines/EDOS Guidelines.pdf, 2,927 words (~3.8k tokens), the one annotators applied (paper sec 3.4). 4,854 sexist items, 4 labels (443/2271/1665/475). Annotators: 19 trained, 3 per item, expert adjudication: VERIFIED. No published human agreement ceiling (UNVERIFIED/absent); best model macro-F1 0.7326, our derived single-annotator match with final label 0.64. Downloaded 15.5 MB (aggregated csv sha 607bdbb7..., individual annotations, guideline pdf).
- FOMC: USABLE, gap likely small. CC BY-NC 4.0 (HF card, paper abstract, GitHub LICENSE.md), verified. Guide = paper Table 10 + Sec 3, ~800 tokens. 2,480 sentences, 3 labels. Agreement: raw percent 0.89-0.95 (Table 9), not kappa. Annotators: two researchers with finance coursework, not a trained workforce. Downloaded HF train/test csv (0.5 MB).
- CAP NYT front page: USABLE WITH CAVEATS. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for project variables; NYT copyright applies to headline text (comparativeagendas.net/pages/Copyright-and-Legal). Codebook 87 pp (~38.9k tokens). No reliability figure found: UNVERIFIED. Subset of 6 economic majors = 3,447 headlines. Downloaded 3.5 MB csv + 0.5 MB codebook. Bills file (116 MB) skipped.
- ASAP-SAS: SKIP. Kaggle terms not retrievable without login (UNVERIFIED); only public copy found (HF nlpatunt/D_ASAP-SAS) has labels removed. Nothing downloaded.
- Gab Hate Corpus fallback not researched (outside the four assigned).
Recommendation for R2/R3: EDOS and CAP-NYT (largest S-to-F nuance), FOMC as a cheap third; skip ASAP-SAS.
